Question kind: invariant_properties

Question:
Use the full test suite in `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestConditionsBuildCnfClosureDictSizeLoopInvariantSuiteQA` (23 tests). Each test instantiates `cfnlint.conditions.conditions.Conditions(cfn)` against a different shape of CloudFormation template -- parameter-comparison Conditions, static-True/static-False Conditions, multiple Conditions sharing a parameter, duplicate-hash Conditions that exercise the early `continue` branch, Conditions composed via `Fn::And` / `Fn::Or` / `Fn::Not` and named-condition references (`Condition: Name`), Conditions comparing pseudo Refs (`AWS::Region`, `AWS::Partition`), Conditions with single- and multi-assertion Rules (including a rules-only template), Conditions whose parameters carry `AllowedValues` driving iteration 2 of `_build_cnf`, and high-volume mixes that exercise all of the above in a single template. `Conditions.__init__` calls `_build_cnf`, which defines an inner closure `_build_equal_vars(c_equals)` (qualname `cfnlint.conditions.conditions.Conditions._build_cnf.<locals>._build_equal_vars`) that mutates two enclosing-scope dicts: `equal_vars` and `equals`. Within `for c_equal in c_equals:`, an entry is added to `equal_vars` at one of lines 124/126/128 (depending on `c_equal.is_static`) and an entry is added to `equals` at line 139. Across the entire test-suite execution, consider every Python `line` event of the inner closure whose `lineno == 139` (i.e., the moment immediately BEFORE the `equals[c_equal.hash] = c_equal` statement is executed). At every such event, is the loop invariant `len(equal_vars) == len(equals)` always held? Return JSON as `{\"invariant_exists\": <bool>}` where `true` means the invariant holds at every observed event and `false` means it does not.

- files/tests/qa/testcase.py
